text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! I'm raring to go! I wanna run
already!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
After all, breakfast today was carrot
rice, I had a
dream that the carrot
princess said I'd win, and...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I've been training so hard with you! I
can't lose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You can bet on me! Okay! Here I gooo!
